gloss: application (of ointment, cream, paint, etc.); spreading on a surface

definitions.gloss: application (of ointment, cream, paint, etc.); spreading on a surface
definitions.explanation: The act of applying a substance (typically medicine, ointment, or cream) to a surface, especially skin. A formal or technical term commonly found in medical instructions and pharmaceutical labeling.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{患部|かんぶ}→患部：18653_kanbu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塗布|とふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Apply the medicine to the affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧、{軟膏|なんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗布|とふ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please apply the ointment three times a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三十分前|さんじゅっぷんまえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{塗布|とふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効果的|こうかてき}→効果的：04793_koukateki⟧です。
examples.english: Applying sunscreen thirty minutes before going out is most effective.

notes:
A formal term for applying or spreading a substance onto a surface, most commonly used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts. In everyday speech, ⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧ is the standard verb for applying or spreading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗布|とふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply medicine
- {軟膏|なんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{塗布|とふ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to apply ointment
- {塗布|とふ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧: amount to apply
- {塗布|とふ}⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧: application surface

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{塗|ぬ}る→塗る：01174_nuru⟧: to paint, to apply — everyday verb for spreading substances on surfaces
- ⟦{散布|さんぷ}→散布：21064_sanpu⟧: spraying, scattering — applying a substance by spraying rather than direct contact
